limits: Memory is optional and initially limited to verified unique image-word pairs in two source families.
Each board has two or three pairs, without discarding source pairs. The reflection timer covers the whole board.
A wrong pair remains visible until the next unmatched card is flipped.
Found pairs complete the Solo board even if prior guesses were wrong; guesses and errors are shown separately.
Online synchronized memory boards, cold-start offline, other pair sources and complete Loto M12 rules remain open.
Physical ENI and phone testing remains open; native Chromium uses CDP touch, real mouse and keyboard.
